graph.title: LEGO City 7634-1 Tractor
notes: The L3 'two separate groups' finding is not a real problem for this manual, so it is kept deliberately. The two groups are the tractor (73 pieces, fully connected) and the shovel (b71). The booklet (pages 3 and 19) shows the shovel only held in the farmer minifigure's hand, and it never attaches to the tractor. The minifigure is not in the official parts list, so it is not a node. Linking the shovel to the tractor would invent a connection the booklet does not show.
The booklet is only pictures; many placements (which stud rows, which beam positions) are inferred, so most stud joins use null ports. Some pieces are placed approximately.

Pin/bar arrangement at the rear (2780 pins, yellow 4L bar, 32013 connectors, 6553 bucket arms) is read from small drawings. The pins are inserted into the rear of the 1x12 bricks and carry the 32013 connectors. The bar is joined to both pins.

The headlight pieces (trans-clear plate with two round plates, the red grille tile) and the DBG 1x2 plate are placed from tiny drawings. The DBG 1x2 plate (b72) is placed on the hood and may be wrong.
The two 3623 plates and two 3020/3710 plates in steps 3, 9 and 12 are assigned by best guess.
There is a single sticker sheet. It is attached to one hood brick, although the booklet shows stickers in steps 14 and 21.
Bucket 2512 is attached to a 2817 plate that carries the blue axle pins and black 6553 arms.
